files.broken.py:
import os,subprocess,sys
r,w=os.pipe()
script='trap "" PIPE; cat input; rc=$?; printf "%s\n" "$rc" > status; exec 1>recovery; printf "recovered\n"'
side=subprocess.Popen([sys.argv[1],'--noprofile','--norc','-c',script],stdout=w,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
os.close(w)
try:
 data=b''
 while len(data)<4096:
  chunk=os.read(r,4096-len(data))
  if not chunk:break
  data+=chunk
finally:os.close(r)
try:_,err=side.communicate(timeout=5)
except BaseException:
 side.kill();side.wait();raise
assert side.returncode==0,side.returncode
print('prefix='+('exact' if data==b'x'*4096 else 'other'))
print('diagnostic='+('EPIPE' if b'Broken pipe' in err else 'other'))
sys.stderr.buffer.write(err)

cases.comparison: The supervisor verifies the first 4096 bytes before closing the pipe. SIGPIPE is ignored so cat reports EPIPE; exact status, diagnostic bytes and subsequent shell output are compared.
